pediatricPearls: Use pediatric dosing of medications or electrical therapy for a pediatric patient < 37 kg and as defined by HandTevy.
Pediatric hypotension is defined as SBP < 70 + (age in years x 2) mmHg

pl1: Aspirin if suspected ACS Chest Pain
Consider CPAP with PEEP with rales/rhonchi indicating wet lung sounds
Nitroglycerin topical paste to chest wall if SBP > 100mmHg
4 lead and 12 lead ECG placement and acquisition
pl3: Monitoring and interpretation of ECG, waveform EtCO
pl5: Rapid sequence induction as needed to secure patent airway for oxygenation and ventilation.
